text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela will pay a state visit to the Philippines on October 17-18, crowning a turnaround in relations between the two countries, President Fidel Ramos said on Wednesday.
The visit will be the first ever to the Philippines by the head of state of a country whose previous "racist policy" of apartheid Filipinos had strongly opposed, Ramos said in a statement.

He said South Africa's democratic transformation paralleled the Philippines' experience in the 1986 popular revolt that ousted late president Ferdinand Marcos and restored democracy to the Pacific nation.
